title: Advogado(A)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Transformar o futuro começa agora e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada. Somos o Grupo Equatorial, a primeira empresa de multisserviços brasileira, com atuação nos setores de distribuição, geração renovável e comercialização de energia, saneamento, telecomunicações e serviços. Estamos presentes em diversas regiões do país, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de soluções que impulsionam o desenvolvimento e geram impacto positivo para a sociedade. Com uma trajetória marcada pela expansão que se transforma em oportunidades, seguimos crescendo com responsabilidade e abrindo espaço para novas ideias, culturas e perspectivas, comprometidos com a evolução constante das pessoas e dos negócios. Para nós, os desafios são uma oportunidade de crescimento e o trabalho em conjunto nos leva mais longe. Se você busca evoluir sua carreira e contribuir com um time que valoriza diferentes trajetórias e acredita no potencial de cada pessoa, seu lugar é aqui. Advogado(a) Vamos, juntos, transformar colaboração em resultado?

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Elaboração de defesas, manifestações e recursos em processos cíveis de valor e complexidade intermediária;
  • Apoio na condução de audiências de instrução e julgamento, bem como em sessões de conciliação;
  • Acompanhamento processual em 1ª e 2ª instância, garantindo a atualização tempestiva dos sistemas internos;
  • Elaboração de pareceres e notas técnicas em temas de responsabilidade civil, contratos e relações de consumo;
  • Suporte jurídico em demandas relacionadas a inadimplementos contratuais, cobranças e indenizações;
  • Apoio nas análises de risco e provisionamento de contingências judiciais;
  • Interlocução com escritórios terceirizados para alinhamento de estratégias processuais;
  • Apoio em notificações extrajudiciais, ofícios e comunicações institucionais;
  • Monitoramento de prazos, diligências externas e demandas de e-mail relacionadas ao contencioso cível.
Requisitos e qualificações

Nível de escolaridade: Superior completo
Formação requerida: DIREITO
Competências técnicas: Domínio prático do Código Civil e do Código de Processo Civil, com foco em execuções, cumprimento de sentença e ações indenizatórias. Conhecimento da Lei de Defesa do Consumidor e aplicação em demandas de responsabilidade civil. Experiência com acompanhamento processual eletrônico (PJe, e-SAJ, Projudi, etc.) e gestão de prazos. Capacidade de elaborar peças processuais estratégicas de forma clara e fundamentada. Familiaridade com indicadores de contingência judicial e relatórios de risco.

Por Que Se Inscrever

Ao fazer parte do Grupo Equatorial, você entra em uma empresa em expansão, com uma cultura que valoriza o desenvolvimento contínuo, a diversidade de talentos e o compromisso com o futuro. Aqui, propósito e resultado caminham juntos.

Benefícios Pensados Para Apoiar Sua Jornada
  • Cuidado
    Plano de Saúde e Odontológico com coparticipação, para você e sua família (dependentes diretos);
    Seguro de vida que protege seu presente e seu futuro;
    Auxílio-creche.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi... my name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture, and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You will also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

  • Ensino superior completo em: Administração de Empresas, Economia, Matemática, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão Comercial ou áreas afins;

  • Experiência comprodutos e serviços financeiros;
  • Experiência comgestão de pessoas e na área de negócios em agência ou experiência similar de mercado;

  • Ter CNH B e veículo próprio;

  • Cadastro

  • Entrevista Presencial

Somos o Sicredi, a primeira Instituição Financeira Cooperativa do Brasil

Muito prazer, nós somos o Sicredi. Nossa trajetória começou há mais de 120 anos, como a primeira instituição financeira cooperativa do Brasil. São elas que nos tornam a Melhor Empresa Para Trabalhar , ocupando novamente a primeira posição, segundo o Great Place To Work Brasil (GPTW).

Junto a mais de 9 milhões de associados, em todos os estados do país, acreditamos no poder da cooperação para construir uma sociedade mais próspera e gerar impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Um propósito que nos une e nos inspira, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e sustentável, a educação e a inclusão financeira.

Seguimos buscando talentos que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor e queremos contar com você. #VemSerSicredi!

Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part‑Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours .

Hi, My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and plan email flows. For example, an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time – not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more.

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business, testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations, and taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts – planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness). My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast‑moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one!

So let's start.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services.

Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling!...An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!

We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? .

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way.

You will also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.

The Contract Details Are As Follows

USD 1,400 a month

25 hrs a week

Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle.

That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.

If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ).

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

leading the way in cloud infrastructure, advanced robotics, enabling AI, blockchain, autonomous cars and smart things. The marketing team at Canonical drives commercial outcomes for the company across its portfolio of products and grows the addressable market through digital marketing campaigns, lifecycle management, events, partnerships and community development. If these things are important to you and you’re driven by driving growth, delighting customers and filling the sales funnel, we want to talk with you.

Job Summary

Canonical is looking for a partner marketing lead who will develop strategic relationships with global partners. Canonical partners with leading technology companies across public cloud (Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Oracle), silicon (ARM, Intel, Qualcomm, Mediatek, Nvidia, Xilinx), hardware vendors (Dell, HP, HPE, Lenovo). The scope of our partnership grows annually (GSIs, software vendors, IoT). The partner marketing lead will drive successful marketing activities with partners and shape our partner programs.

Responsibilities
  • Lead a team of partner marketing managers
  • Grow partner sales through integrated partner marketing programs across system integrators, public cloud, device manufacturers and semiconductors
  • Develop scalable, efficient marketing campaigns to promote Canonical products globally
  • Build and enhance the value proposition of co‑marketing programs for existing and prospective partners
  • Ensure partner marketing consistency with the Ubuntu brand and value proposition
  • Establish and support relationships with partner sales, channel, and marketing teams to improve partner sales potential for Canonical products, services, and technologies
  • Understand partner business strategies and objectives;
    craft co‑marketing strategies and programs benefiting both Canonical and partners
  • Advocate for mutual business development and build customer demand for partner products to grow sales
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of B2B marketing experience working with strategic corporate partners on co‑marketing initiatives
  • Experience in enterprise software, SaaS or silicon (preferred)
  • Strong customer/partner relationship management skills
  • Proven analytical skills, assessing opportunities and making ROI-based decisions
  • Track record of delivering strong results and innovation
  • Growth mindset and willingness to take risks and roll up sleeves
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to thrive in a self‑starter, fast‑paced, changing environment
What Canonical Offers
  • Learning and Development
  • Annual Compensation Review
  • Recognition Rewards
  • Annual Leave
  • Priority Pass for travel

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Job Description

Our Medical Affairs team advances patient care by engaging in scientific exchange with external medical experts and industry professionals ensuring the scientific value of our products is realized. We engage and train internal employees to ensure that they thoroughly comprehend the science behind the medicine and review further unmet medical needs to bolster collaboration and further differentiate our portfolio.

Description

MSL (Medical Scientific Liaisons) are scientifically trained and credentialed therapeutic area disease and product experts who engage in non-promotional scientific exchange with Scientific Leaders or Key Decision Makers. MSL interactions with Scientific Leaders and Key Decision Makers are built on the credibility of the scientific exchange held. MSLs (Medical Scientific Liaisons) develop and execute on action plans aligned with the Guiding Principles for example US Global Medical Affairs / Oncology Global Medical Affairs External Stakeholder-Facing Activities local and global company policies local rules & regulations and the Medical Affairs Plan (MAP).

Responsibilities

The MSL (Medical Scientific Liaisons) is responsible for ensuring that he / she is fully versed in the therapeutic area and up to date on all major studies both ongoing and completed product information on our company and other companies relevant therapies clinical data and relevant pipeline data to provide the most balanced data to Scientific Leaders Key Decision Makers and the healthcare community to improve patient care.

Requirements

Bachelors degree in Life Sciences;

Masters or PhD in cardiology pulmonology or related areas will be considered a differential;

Advanced English;

Ability to interpret data and scientific articles;

Travel is a requirement.

Benefits

We are a research-driven biopharmaceutical company. Our mission is built on the simple premise that if we follow the science that great medicines can make a significant impact to our world. We believe that a research-driven enterprise dedicated to world-class science can succeed by inventing medicine and vaccine innovations that make a difference for patients across the globe.

title: Medical Science Liaison, Metabolics
description:
Why Join Us

Be a hero for our rare disease patients

At Ultragenyx we fundamentally believe that taking real impactful action to care for the needs of patients and our people is always the right thing to achieve this goal our vision is to lead the future of rare disease medicine. For us this means going where other biopharma companies wont go challenging the status quo and creating a new model that advances our field so more patients and caregivers can benefit from life-changing treatments. We do this by following the science applying a novel rapid development approach making innovative medicines at fair and reasonable prices and creating a collaborative ecosystem to reach patients in ways that are most meaningful for them.

Our commitment and care for patients extends to our people so culture is an essential cornerstone for Ulyx. We remain continuously focused on creating a supportive and inclusive environment of profound learning and growth so employees can thrive in all areas of their lives in and outside of we want to be an organization where we would be proud for our family friends and children to work.

If you want to have a meaningful impact do the best work of your career and grow a lot both professionally andpersonally come join our team .

Position Summary

ultra innovative Tackle rare and dynamic challenges

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a member of a field-based team of scientists who function as an extension of the Medical Affairs organization. MSLs are responsible for developing and enhancing professional relationships with medical thought leaders involved in various phases of product development as well as key medical organizations including treatment centers of excellence and established societies and associations. MSLs provide medical information through scientific exchange in a fair-balanced manner and provide clinical / scientific support to the company.

The MSL will help to integrate the efforts of the Medical Affairs Department with R&D Clinical Affairs and Scientific Affairs and with other internal teams to ensure effective selection and execution of investigator-initiated clinical trials. The incumbent will also provide clinical and educational support to managed care organizations as well as identify influential senior clinicians on the national and regional level.

This is a field-based position based out of Porto Alegre or Curitiba and requires professionals with established personal and scientific creditability to interact with thought leaders and centers of excellence. This MSL position will support companys products in development and brands as their primary responsibility. The ideal candidate will possess an understanding of rare diseases development.

Work Model

Field : Officially documented as working as a member of the Ultragenyx field team based out of Rio Grande do Sul or Puraná generally interacting with third parties on behalf of Ultragenyx.

Responsibilities
  • Identify Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and establish and maintain scientific relationships with KOLs;
    connecting to KOLs in academic and community centers
  • Using the science behind our products supports treatment for patients with rare and ultra-rare diseases
  • Act as primary liaison to investigators interested in developing and performing investigator-initiated research
  • Develop and execute territory plans in alignment with country-level plans
  • Provide clinical presentations and medical information in response to unsolicited questions (as appropriate) in academic community and healthcare provider settings
  • Provide medical information through scientific exchange and disseminate scientific publications
  • Provide clinical disease state presentations to key stakeholders including Payers
  • Collaborate with the Clinical Operations organization to enhance patient enrolment in company-sponsored clinical trials by identifying appropriate clinical trial sites and interacting with investigators in ongoing studies
  • Provide Scientific and Medical information updates
  • Provide scientific support at medical congresses
  • Provide timely medical insights / information on emerging clinical / scientific teams and opportunities to internal stakeholders
  • Provide scientific support for appropriate educational initiatives
  • Ensure all activities are compliant with company policies and SOPs
  • Seek out opportunities to support the MSL value proposition achieve results and set an example for others to follow by consistently demonstrating Ultragenyx cultural attributes and core competencies
  • Be compliant with Ultragenyx Code of Conduct policies and procedures
Requirements
  • Medical Doctor (2 years of MSL experience desirable)
  • Advanced written and spoken level of English
  • Rare disease experience preferred particularly in metabolic genetic diseases
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills required
  • Demonstrated experience effectively presenting clinical / scientific information required
  • Expert understanding of the local health care delivery system and its impact on patient care and regional medical care
  • Models our Core Values #Dynamic #Possibility #Generous #Relentness #Courageous and is experienced as someone who exemplifies the culture we want to create;
    operates with transparency;
    is trusted
  • Ability to relate and work with a wide range of people to achieve results
  • Ability to organize and prioritize own work schedule
  • Ability to make decisions which have a significant impact on the departments credibility operations and services
  • Ability to create materials such as reports presentations for inside and outside the organization and present / speak to groups
  • Time and territory management skills required
  • Approximately 50-60% of travel is required;
    overnight travel is required as needed

Buscamos un Medical Science Liaison (MSL) altamente motivado y con sólida formación científica para unirse a nuestro equipo médico en São Paulo. title: Medical Science Liaison (Msl) - Hematologia
description:
Medical Science Liaison (MSL) - Hematologia

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Remote, 70% field visits)

JUNTE-SE À MISSÃO DA AMGEN DE SERVIR AOS PACIENTES. Na Amgen, se você sente que faz parte de algo maior, é porque realmente faz. Nossa missão compartilhada — servir aos pacientes que vivem com doenças graves — impulsiona tudo o que fazemos. Desde somos pioneiros no mundo da biotecnologia em nossa luta contra as doenças mais difíceis do mundo. Com nosso foco em quatro áreas terapêuticas — Oncologia, Inflamação, Medicina Geral e Doenças Raras — alcançamos milhões de pacientes a cada ano.

Como membro da equipe Amgen, você ajudará a causar um impacto duradouro na vida dos pacientes enquanto pesquisamos, fabricamos e entregamos medicamentos inovadores para ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas, plenas e felizes. Nossa cultura premiada é colaborativa, inovadora e baseada na ciência. Se você tem paixão por desafios e pelas oportunidades que eles oferecem, você prosperará como parte da equipe Amgen. Junte-se a nós e transforme a vida dos pacientes enquanto transforma sua carreira.

O que você fará

O Medical Science Liaison é um profissional altamente qualificado da indústria farmacêutica, responsável por estabelecer uma relação científica com médicos e especialistas da área. Atua como ponto de contato entre a Amgen e os profissionais de saúde, com foco em oferecer informações científicas detalhadas, dados clínicos, apoio para a utilização adequada de medicamentos e coleta de insights importantes para a estratégia médica da área terapêutica.

Responsabilidades principais
  • Construir e Manter Relacionamentos Científicos: Estabelecer uma rede de contatos com líderes de opinião chave (KOLs) e outros profissionais de saúde para discutir dados clínicos e avanços terapêuticos.
  • Educação Científica: Fornecer apresentações científicas detalhadas sobre a doença e os produtos e pesquisas atuais para médicos, profissionais da saúde, hospitais e grupos de saúde.
  • Suporte Clínico: Fornecer feedback de especialistas da área sobre os produtos.
  • Apoio às Equipes Internas: Trabalhar de perto com equipes de marketing, vendas e acesso para garantir a precisão das informações científicas e apoiar no desenvolvimento de estratégias.
  • Desenvolver e Realizar Treinamentos: Realizar sessões de treinamento interno e externos para garantir que as partes interessadas compreendam os aspectos científicos dos produtos e áreas terapêuticas.
  • Avaliar e Coletar Feedback Clínicos e de Mercado: Identificar tendências no tratamento de doenças e novas necessidades no mercado, proporcionando insights valiosos para a estratégia da empresa.
Qualificações Básicas
  • Doutorado
  • Mestrado + 1-3 anos de experiência em Assuntos Médicos
  • Bacharelado + 2-4 anos de experiência em Assuntos Médicos
Qualificações Desejáveis
  • Graduação completa em área relacionada à saúde (Medicina, Farmácia, Biomedicina, Enfermagem, etc)
  • Experiência prévia como Medical Science Liaison (MSL), em posição similar na área de Assuntos Médicos, em farmacêutica clínica ou como enfermeira / o navegador, com vivência comprovada em Hematologia.
  • Inglês avançado
  • Excelente comunicação científica.
  • Capacidade de construir relacionamento com líderes de opinião médica (KOLs).
  • Pensamento estratégico, perfil colaborativo e proativo.
Benefícios

Além do salário base, a Amgen oferece pacotes de compensação competitivos e abrangentes, alinhados aos padrões da indústria local. Como uma organização dedicada a melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas ao redor do mundo, a Amgen promove um ambiente inclusivo, com pessoas diversas, éticas, comprometidas e altamente qualificadas, que se respeitam mutuamente e vivem os valores da Amgen para continuar avançando na ciência a serviço dos pacientes.

Declaração de EEO

A Amgen não discrimina em suas oportunidades de emprego com base em sexo, raça, cor, idade, nacionalidade, ideias políticas ou religiosas, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nível e tipo deficiência, origem étnica ou qualquer outra categoria protegida por lei. E fazemos um convite especial às pessoas que se autodeclaram pretas e pardas, LGBTQIAP+, possuem algum tipo de deficiência, tenham +50 anos e mulheres que buscam por posições de liderança, para que conheçam mais sobre a Amgen e nossas oportunidades de carreira, pois temos como compromisso gerar oportunidades para grupos minorizados e criar um ambiente cada vez mais diverso e inclusivo. Garantiremos que pessoas com deficiência recebam acomodações razoáveis para participar do processo de candidatura ou entrevista, para desempenhar funções essenciais do cargo e para receber outros benefícios e privilégios de emprego. Entre em contato conosco para solicitar uma acomodação.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Hi...

My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go!

Running Tours.

This is not your usual job post.

Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go!

Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply.

Maybe many will.

I just need one really good one!

So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and ping!

  • … an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Whoop whoop!

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time.

Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!

We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.

Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business.

Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations.

Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground.

We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data / automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts.

That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.

We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.

If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role.

I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that 'makes sense' to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion).

Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)).

My guess is that if you are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week.

All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done.

There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way.

We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with).

It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work.

The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should. The contract details are as follows:

USD 1,400 a month

25 hrs a week

Managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses.

I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values.

We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself.

But the most important skill of all is: execution.

If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think.

I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me

with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go!

Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far,

LenaNote: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

Mafra Hospitalar – uma empresa Viveo.

Cuidar de cada vida simples assim!

Mafra Hospitalar atua como distribuidora líder de materiais e medicamentos hospitalares no mercado brasileiro. A Mafra atua como uma parceira estratégica para o setor, garantindo que hospitais e clínicas tenham acesso rápido e eficiente a um extenso portfólio de produtos, que abrange mais de 6.500 itens. title: Jovem Aprendiz - Ajuricaba/Rs - Sicredi Das Culturas Rs/Mg
description:
Descrição da vaga

O programa Jovem Aprendiz é uma excelente oportunidade para iniciar a trajetória profissional. Durante o período que passarem conosco, vocês terão oportunidades de estudar temas relacionados ao mercado de trabalho, e também aprender na prática a realidade de uma organização corporativa e Cooperativa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O jovem aprendiz terá como responsabilidade participar das aulas teóricas ministradas pela instituição de ensino parceira do Sicredi nos dias e horários estipulados.

Irá compartilhar o aprendizado de sala de aula, contribuindo para a melhoria e inovação das atividades que forem realizar.

Terá atividades voltadas à área administrativa de forma geral.

Aqui você irá aprender e se desenvolver!

Terá liberdade de contribuir!

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Estar cursando ensino médio ou superior (preferencialmente os cursos: Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins).
  • Ter idade entre 16 e 22 anos.
  • Ter disponibilidade de 4h diárias, necessariamente à manhã.
  • Residir em Ajuricaba/RS.
  • Ter Carteira de Trabalho.
  • Experiência na área? Não precisa, a gente te ensina, e te permite conhecer tudo o que somos! Afinal, não contratamos apenas jovens aprendizes, mas sim o Futuro da nossa Cooperativa.
Informações adicionais
  • Benefícios: Vale Transporte.
Etapas do processo
  • Cadastro.
  • Testes Comportamentais (Fit Cultural e PDA).
  • Bate papo GP.
  • Entrevista com Gestor.
  • Contratação.
Sobre o Sicredi

Somos o Sicredi, a primeira Instituição Financeira Cooperativa do Brasil.

Muito prazer, nós somos o Sicredi. Nossa trajetória começou há mais de 120 anos, como a primeira instituição financeira cooperativa do Brasil. Hoje, seguimos crescendo e nos transformando a cada dia, ao lado de mais de 50 mil pessoas colaboradoras. São elas que nos tornam a Melhor Empresa Para Trabalhar, ocupando novamente a primeira posição, segundo o Great Place To Work Brasil (GPTW).

Junto a mais de 9 milhões de associados, em todos os estados do país, acreditamos no poder da cooperação para construir uma sociedade mais próspera e gerar impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Um propósito que nos une e nos inspira, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e sustentável, a educação e a inclusão financeira.

Seguimos buscando talentos que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor e queremos contar com você. #VemSerSicredi!

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.
Whoop whoop! Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should.The Contract Details Are As Follows USD 1,400 a month 25 hrs a week Managed via UpworkOh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** w ith a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, LenaNote: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.Seniority level

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one. So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You’ll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time, not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows: USD 1,400 a month, 25 hrs a week, managed via Upwork. Oh, and hey... if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think. I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena. Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

Responsibilities
  • Oversee all marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.
  • Develop and manage newsletters, including copy, automation and data optimisation.
  • Plan, run and optimise digital advertising on Meta, Google and other platforms.
  • Create case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas to reach new runners and companies.
  • Research emerging technologies, trends and new channels to scale growth across markets.
  • Collaborate closely with the founder to align marketing strategy with company goals.
Contract Details

USD 1,400 a month, 25 hours a week, managed via Upwork. Remote, part‑time role with minimal internal meetings.

Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.


Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one!


So let's start.


Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services.


Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.


We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling!... an email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop!


Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing, and voilà: now you nailed it!


Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world!


We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right? .


I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.


Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way.


You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).


You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that\ "makes sense\" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!


Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!


We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.


The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you - running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.


Contract Details

  • Monthly salary: USD 1,400

  • Hours per week: 25 hrs

  • Platform: Managed via Upwork


Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.


The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle.


That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea.


If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ).


Thanks for reading this far,


Lena

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode.

If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

  • Admitir os pacientes na unidade, de forma humanizada, solicitando os documentos necessários e efetuando os devidos registros e controles internos, observando leis do exercício profissional e normativas internas e externas;

  • Detectar e comunicar aos órgãos competentes, respeitando fluxo interno, a existência de pacientes portadores de doenças de notificação compulsória;
  • Participar de programas de qualidade da unidade, incluindo coleta de informações;
  • Interagir com os demais departamentos da instituição e áreas envolvidas no atendimento ao paciente, buscando o aprimoramento técnico e troca de experiências para melhoria constante das atividades da área;
  • Colaborar e participar na implementação de protocolos de atendimento, pesquisa e ensino;
  • Participar de reuniões, cursos, palestras e treinamentos que envolvam atendimento especializado e ou rotinas e normativas a serem implementadas/implantadas;
  • Preencher e visar mapas de produção e ou formulários necessários ao atendimento/tratamento do paciente e/ou necessidade da Instituição;
  • Executar tarefas afins, inclusive as editadas no respectivo regulamento da profissão necessárias à execução das atividades próprias do cargo;
  • Manter a chefiae equipe informada sobre as atividades e problemas sob sua responsabilidade.

  • Ensino superior em Medicina completo;
  • Especialização médica na área de atuação;
  • Informática em nível avançado;
  • CRM ativo.

Em recente debate sobre a Lei de Recuperação Judicial e Falências (Lei 11.101/2005), nosso sócio fundador Thomas Felsberg destacou que embora a legislação seja considerada moderna e alinhada às práticas internacionais, algumas interpretações acabam destoando de sua essência.Segundo ele, o artigo 47, que cuida do objeto da recuperação judicial, deve ser compreendido não como um instrumento de proteção à insolvência, mas como uma ferramenta estratégica para fortalecer a recuperação de crédito através da recuperação da empresa insolvente— contribuindo assim para a manutenção do PIB, da arrecadação e dos empregos.Essa análise foi destacada em artigo publicado pelo JOTA, que cobriu o evento “Panorama da Recuperação de Crédito em Bancos Públicos”, realizado pelo BNDES, no Rio de Janeiro.Entenda por que a recuperação de crédito através da reorganização da empresa é um pilar estratégico para o desenvolvimento econômico, leia a matéria no link: #FelsbergAdvogados #RecuperaçãoJudicial #Falências #DireitoEmpresarial #BNDES #Jota

Na Semeraro Advogados, estamos em constante crescimento e buscamos profissionais que desejam fazer a diferença e crescer conosco. Se você quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance, aqui é o seu lugar!

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos à procura de um Advogado Júnior com experiência em Direito de Família para integrar nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ser dinâmico, proativo e ter paixão por ajudar nossos clientes a resolverem questões familiares com sensibilidade e profissionalismo.

É fundamental que o candidato resida na cidade de São Paulo, SP.

Responsabilidades
  • Funções Jurídicas:
    • Elaborar petições iniciais, recursos e outras manifestações jurídicas, principalmente na área de direito de família, mas também na área cível.
    • Acompanhar clientes em audiências.
    • Participar de reuniões com clientes e equipe, tanto presenciais quanto telepresenciais.
    • Auxiliar na organização da controladoria jurídica.
    • Atender clientes ativos, fornecendo atualizações sobre processos em andamento.
    • Manter contato com cartórios para facilitar processos extrajudiciais.
  • Função Comercial:
    • Gerenciar atendimentos via WhatsApp para fechamento de novos contratos.
    • Conduzir reuniões presenciais e por videoconferência, além de gerenciar o envio de propostas e contratos.
  • Funções Administrativas e Financeiras:
    • Inserir dados no sistema ASTREA e auxiliar na abertura de cadastros.
    • Elaborar e-mails para clientes e gerenciar cobranças de honorários.
    • Gerenciar o atendimento de leads no boot do escritório.
  • Funções de Marketing:
    • Criar posts para redes sociais do escritório e auxiliar na gravação de vídeos para as redes do escritório.
    • Pesquisar e informar sobre novidades no Direito de Família.
Tipo de Contratação

Advogado associado, período integral (09h às 18h, com 1h de almoço).

Trabalho híbrido (maior parte do tempo é remoto / homeoffice) com atividades presenciais em São Paulo (SP), para atendimento de reuniões e audiências.

Remuneração e Benefícios
  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado, e bônus anual baseado em metas.
  • Progressão de carreira conforme plano interno.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento contínuos.
Requisitos
  • Residência em São Paulo, SP.
  • Formação em Direito com OAB / SP ativa.
  • Experiência em Direito de Família.
  • Familiaridade com software jurídico.
  • Organização, cumprimento de prazos.
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade em trabalhar em equipe são fundamentais.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com CRM e atendimento via WhatsApp.
  • Conhecimento em marketing digital e produção de conteúdo.
  • Ser proativo na solução de problemas.

title: Advogado(A) Junior - Jurídico Societário
description:
Job description

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time.

Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente do Jurídico Societário, para trabalhar de forma híbrida na cidade de Belo Horizonte.

Ao assumir o cargo de Advogado Júnior na Afya, seu objetivo principal será apoiar a área societária da Afya, elaborando e revisando atos societários, contratos e registros legais.

Atuará em projetos de reestruturação societária, manutenção de livros e cumprimento de obrigações regulatórias.

  • Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.
Main responsibilities

Profissional responsável por apoiar as atividades jurídicas da área societária da Afya, com foco na elaboração e revisão de documentos societários, suporte em operações de reestruturação societária e acompanhamento de rotinas corporativas de empresas do grupo.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Elaborar e revisar procurações, atas, contratos sociais, alterações contratuais, estatutos e demais atos societários.
  • Apoiar na coordenação e execução de projetos de reestruturação societária, incluindo fusões, incorporações, cisões e reorganizações internas.
  • Auxiliar na manutenção e atualização de livros societários e registros perante órgãos competentes (Juntas Comerciais e cartórios).
  • Apoiar o cumprimento de obrigações legais e regulatórias relacionadas à estrutura societária das empresas do grupo.
  • Revisar documentos jurídicos e societários para assegurar conformidade com a legislação vigente e com as políticas internas de governança.
  • Interagir com escritórios externos e áreas internas para alinhamento de documentos e execução de procedimentos societários.
  • Apoiar na organização de pastas corporativas e bases de dados jurídicas, garantindo rastreabilidade e controle documental.
Requirements and skills

Formação: Bacharelado em Direito concluído.

Registro ativo na OAB.

Experiência prévia com direito societário em escritório de advocacia ou departamento jurídico corporativo.

Conhecimento prático em elaboração de atos societários e trâmites junto às Juntas Comerciais.

Domínio do Pacote Office e boa capacidade de organização documental.

Desejável conhecimento em operações de M&A e estrutura societária de companhias abertas.

Inglês avançado será considerado um diferencial.

Additional information

Confira os principais abaixo :

  • Para o dia a dia: Vale-alimentação / refeição;
    Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
    Vale-transporte (para vagas Híbridas ou Presenciais);
    PLR.
  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.
  • Família, Saúde e Bem-estar: Gympass / Wellhub;
    Psicologia Viva (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista);
    Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
    Seguro de Vida;
    Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
    Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
    Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
    Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).
  • Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado: Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
    Academia de idiomas (AIA);
    Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
    Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
    Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.
  • Diferencial para Professor Médico: Assinatura premium do Afya iClinic e Afya Whitebook.

  • Atuar de forma proativa na defesa dos interesses da empresa em processos tributários nas esferas federal, estadual e municipal;

  • Assessorar diretamente os departamentos de contabilidade, planejamento financeiro, supply chain e comercial em todas as matérias de natureza fiscal, garantindo que as operações da empresa estejam alinhadas com a legislação vigente e com as melhores práticas de governança tributária;
  • Apoiar e revisar planejamentos tributários, participar de projetos de reorganização societária e fornecer suporte em operações de Fusões e Aquisições (M&A), analisando os riscos e oportunidades fiscais envolvidos;

Somos 3corações

O Grupo 3corações é uma empresa de gente apaixonada pelo que faz. Crescemos pela força do nosso trabalho, valorizando nossas origens e nossa essência para irmos cada vez mais longe. Somos um povo inovador e empreendedor, que cuida dos colaboradores e proporciona experiências prazerosas para todos com quem nos relacionamos.

Nossa história começou em 1959, no interior do Rio Grande do Norte. Com nosso jeito de ser, inovador e empreendedor, nos tornamos líder nacional no segmento de café torrado e moído e cappuccino e vice-líder em café solúvel. Em 2013, lançamos a solução de máquinas multibebidas TRES, com mais de 30 sabores de bebidas em cápsulas, e, em 2020, a partir da joint venture com a Positive Company, entramos para o mercado plant based, oferecendo aos nossos consumidores produtos 100% naturais, de origem vegetal. Também integram o nosso portfólio itens como café solúvel, cappuccino pronto para beber, achocolatado, café com leite, refrescos, derivados de milho, filtros para café e porta-filtros.

Somos mais de 8 mil corações apaixonados pelo que fazem, e mpenhados em construir um país e um mundo melhores. Respeitamos e damos valor a todas as pessoas e culturas e acreditamos que a diversidade enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho. Buscamos pessoas que querem arregaçar as mangas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Venha para 3corações e junte seu coração aos nossos!

Join NFQ! We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. Financial Senior Consultant

Generate and maintain Confluence documentation for new developments and ongoing maintenance. Support post-production activities (“babysitting”) to ensure operational stability and timely fixes. Collaborate with architects, developers and QA to translate financial rules into testable technical solutions and to automate validation when possible.

Must-Have Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering or related fields.
  • 3+ years of practical experience designing and developing accounting logic and solutions using Oracle PL / SQL.
  • Demonstrable experience in treasury and derivatives accounting (IRS, CCS, IFN, FRA, C&E, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of financial concepts such as calculation bases, NPV, IRR and valuation flows, and of operation life cycles / transaction flows.

  • Strong communication skills, teamwork, responsibility and sense of ownership.
  • Advanced English.
Nice to Have

  • Experience automating accounting processes or integrating accounting systems (ETL / data integration).

  • Familiarity with ETL or data integration tools (e.G., Talend, ADF, Informatica).
  • Advanced Spanish (written and spoken).

Work in a dynamic, international environment with global mobility opportunities. Continuous learning and official certifications. Language classes to boost your global career. A personalized development plan with mentorship and performance-based growth. CLT contract benefits : Health & dental insurance Life insurance Meal voucher Transportation allowance
