#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:
Role

SAP SD Consultant

Location

Brazil (Remote)

Mode

Full Time

Required To Travel once a Month to the work Location at Alagoinhas, Bahia (manufacturing plant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands‑on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.
  • Handle Brazil‑specific localization, including e‑invoicing (NF‑e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS / COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.
  • Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.
  • Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).
  • Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.
  • Provide cutover and hypercare support after go‑live.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e‑transformation and e‑document requirements.
  • Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

title: Senior Sap Consultant
description:
Role

SAP SD Consultant

Location

Brazil (Remote)

Mode

Full Time

Required To Travel once a Month to the work Location at Alagoinhas, Bahia (manufacturing plant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands‑on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.
  • Handle Brazil‑specific localization, including e‑invoicing (NF‑e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS / COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.
  • Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.
  • Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).
  • Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.
  • Provide cutover and hypercare support after go‑live.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e‑transformation and e‑document requirements.
  • Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:
Role

SAP SD Consultant

Location

Brazil (Remote)

Mode

Full Time

Required To Travel once a Month to the work Location at Alagoinhas, Bahia (manufacturing plant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands‑on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.
  • Handle Brazil‑specific localization, including e‑invoicing (NF‑e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS / COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.
  • Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.
  • Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).
  • Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.
  • Provide cutover and hypercare support after go‑live.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e‑transformation and e‑document requirements.
  • Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

title: Partners Marketing Senior Director
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

As the Senior Director of Partner Marketing in Brazil, you will play a pivotal role in upholding our commitment to our partners (gyms, studios, and apps) to Grow Stronger Together.

Your primary focus will be to lead the successful partner positioning of Wellhub within the fitness and wellness industry in Brazil, becoming the go‑to person for all topics related to this matter. You will also lead the BR Partner Marketing squad, developing and executing account‑based marketing strategies that grow and maintain the success of our partners, with a specific focus on our most strategic partners.

This will include managing and developing our relationships with industry associations such as ACAD, working hand‑in‑hand with our broader marketing organisation to identify and leverage the best strategic opportunities across all media types to drive the Wellhub partner positioning. You will develop and implement comprehensive GTM plans for new partner and product launches to drive success across our ecosystem. You will also lead the strategy and execution of our annual presence at industry events such as Fitness Brasil, as well as sponsoring strategic partner summits and conferences.

You will report to the Global Head of Partner Marketing, become a strategic partner to the Heads of Partnerships in Brazil, and will develop close working relationships with industry leaders, authorities and associations. You will join the BR leadership team, working closely with the leaders of other verticals of our business and the country leader.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in developing and leading multi‑channel marketing strategies, executing go‑to‑market and events with multi‑functional teams, as well as exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of managing successful partner programs. General business acumen beyond marketing is also a key element for the position.

YOUR IMPACT
  • Strategic Marketer: Develop and execute the partner marketing strategy for Brazil, working closely with the Global Head of Partner Marketing and Brazil Head of Partnerships to drive partner success and business growth
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with other departments such as Product Development, MarTech, Content Marketing, Revenue Marketing, Corporate Comms and Partnerships to ensure a seamless partner experience and message
  • Executive presence: Present to and collaborate appropriately with SVP and C‑Level executives and stakeholders to align strategic vision and direction
  • Audience Champion: The voice of Wellhub Partners within our Brazilian organisation – championing our partner value proposition and ensuring a partner‑centric approach is upheld across the business
  • Hands‑on Involvement: Be a player‑coach by actively participating in partner marketing initiatives. Roll up your sleeves and work alongside your team to identify and implement the most efficient ways to acquire, engage and retain partners in BR
  • AI Thinking: Apply AI‑powered tools and analytics in developing marketing strategy and leveraging for enhanced productivity and scale, with a focus on partner engagement and growth
  • Budget management: Management of a significant budget to drive our market positioning and deliver exponential value to our strategic partners
  • Live the mission: Inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work‑life wellness.
WHO YOU ARE
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
  • 10+ years of strategic marketing experience
  • Fluent in English as well as BR Portuguese
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills in both languages
  • Based in SP, Brazil, and/or with ease of access to our SP office
  • Proven experience in leading and mentoring teams
  • Strong track record in creating and implementing a marketing strategy to support commercial goals
  • Previous experience in working directly with SVP / C‑level executives
  • Strong analytical skills and a data‑driven approach to marketing strategy and execution
  • An appetite for and experience in leveraging AI to enhance productivity and scale marketing requirements
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment
  • Growth mindset – commitment to continuous learning, experimentation and improvement
  • Passion for health and wellbeing is a must
  • Knowledge and experience of the BR fitness and wellness industry is an added advantage
WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on‑demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp‑back period to return part‑time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world‑class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Voluntary Self Identification

Wellhub is committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive work environment, beginning with the application process. We recognize that we are not all alike, and this is our greatest strength. We hire talented and diverse individuals not only because it is the right thing to do, but also because it strengthens our company. We know that combining our diverse cultures, experiences, and perspectives will help us achieve our mission of making the world a healthier place.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi... My name is Lena, founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with words like driven, team player, high performer, I’ll give you the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let’s start.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

You'll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

You will also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You will also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

The Contract Details Are As Follows

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you're considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow—both the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle.

That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via (contact) with a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version). Thanks for reading this far, Lena.

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter and pling! An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors. Whoop whoop! Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it! Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed ) and in the future, with your help, many more...Right? I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it. I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don't throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works. You'll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we'll back you while you do). You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners! Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies! We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone in any way. We're just on the other side of the world. The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You - Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should. The Contract Details Are As Follows USD 1,400 a month 25 hrs a week Managed via Upwork Oh, and hey... if you're considering this role as an add-on to an already existing full-time job, then hold your horses. I don't believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn't align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow... the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don't execute, we can't move the needle. That's it, I think. I've probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** w ith a short spiel on why you feel you're right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please - we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version ). Thanks for reading this far, Lena Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3-4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer in Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room to Grow Into Head of Marketing

5 days ago. Be among the first 25 applicants.

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter and blah!

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it. Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture, and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, BUT someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you’ll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You’ll also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. We don’t throw spaghetti at the wall here: we test, learn, and scale what works.

You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will be working directly with me in the role. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world and together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!

Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, I focus radically on progress, and I dislike sloppiness (with a passion). Most people, I believe (or at least hope), also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting, and understanding (admittedly still very little understanding for sloppiness ;
-)). My guess is that ifyou are good at what you do and eager to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. Money Should Not Be The Main Motivation For You – Running, Bridging Cultures, And Being Part Of a Fun, Fast-moving, And Positive Company Should.The Contract Details Are As Follows.

  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it. The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle. That’s it, I think.

I’ve probably left out loads of super important things, but at least this gives you some idea. If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thanks for reading this far.

Lena Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3–4 days as we receive many applicants.

title: 0737 - Gerente De Agência - Caçador/Sc
description:
Workplace: Caçador - SC Caçador - SC

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Somos o Sicredi, a primeira instituição financeira cooperativa do Brasil. Nosso modelo de negócio constrói uma cadeia de valor que beneficia o associado, a cooperativa e a comunidade local. Escolhemos trilhar um caminho coletivo para oferecer soluções inteligentes para o seu desenvolvimento financeiro. A gente entende que as melhores escolhas são aquelas que trazem resultados para todos. Oferecemos mais de 300 produtos e serviços financeiros de um jeito simples e próximo para você, para a sua empresa e para o seu agronegócio. Mas o que nos faz diferentes é que ao se associar, você adquire uma pequena cota da sua cooperativa, passando a ser dono do Sicredi, tendo voz sobre as decisões do negócio e participando dos resultados. É por isso que o Sicredi é seu, meu e nosso. Aqui todos têm a oportunidade de decidir e participar, assim criamos laços de confiança que nos permitem crescer. Juntos.

Gestão de Pessoas: Exercer a liderança da equipe.

Prestar consultoria financeira aos associados e demais públicos de interesse, nas dependências da agência e em visitas externas.

Gestão das operações e serviços: Responder pela movimentação financeira da agência, conforme normas e procedimentos institucionalizados.

Planejamento: Liderar, elaborar e executar o planejamento da agência, focando o curto, médio e longo prazo.

Projetar e realizar o encaminhamento das ações necessárias à manutenção e ampliação de associados, a fim de fomentar sua principalidade no Sicredi.

Otimizar resultados no que se refere a custos e rentabilidade, de acordo com o planejado.

Gestão do Risco: Gerir os riscos inerentes as operações da agência, tendo visão global do grau de cada risco, visando a segurança em todos os processos.

Organizar e responder pela gestão dos Programas de Relacionamento em sua agência, incentivando a participação dos associados, visando o desenvolvimento das comunidades e dos negócios.

Representante Legal da agência: Atuar como procurador da Cooperativa, representando em todas as esferas necessárias para o atendimento das questões legai e de negócios.

Gestão de carteira de Associados: Responder pela administração e desenvolvimento de carteira de associados.

Ouvidoria: Realizar a gestão das demandas de ouvidoria junto a equipe visando solucionar os apontamentos e assegurar a resolução de demandas dos associados.

Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, ou áreas relacionadas.

Pós Graduação nas áreas afins;

Possuir certificação CPA 20.

Conhecimento e experiência em Produtos e Serviços Financeiros, Sistema Financeiro Nacional, Matemática Financeira, Negociação, Visão de negócio financeiro.

Conhecimentos e habilidades com Gestão de Equipe e de Agência.

Disponibilidade para residir em Caçador/SC.

Horário de trabalho: 08:30 - 17:30

Vale alimentação/refeição;

Plano de Saúde;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio Educacional (Pós-Graduação, MBA e Especialização);

Auxílio Curso;

Participação no Programa de Resultados;

Adicional por Tempo de Serviço;

Atendimento/orientação Psicológica, Financeira e Jurídica.

Somos o Sicredi, a primeira Instituição Financeira Cooperativa do Brasil

Muito prazer, nós somos o Sicredi.

Nossa trajetória começou há mais de 120 anos, como a primeira instituição financeira cooperativa do Brasil. Hoje, seguimos crescendo e nos transformando a cada dia, ao lado de mais de 50 mil pessoas colaboradoras . São elas que nos tornam aMelhor Empresa Para Trabalhar , ocupando novamente a primeira posição,segundo o Great Place To Work Brasil (GPTW).

Junto a mais de 9 milhões de associados, em todos os estados do país, acreditamos no poder da cooperação para construir uma sociedade mais próspera e gerar impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Um propósito que nos une e nos inspira, promovendo o desenvolvimento local e sustentável, a educação e a inclusão financeira.

Seguimos buscando talentos que queiram fazer parte da construção de um mundo melhor e queremos contar com você. #VemSerSicredi!

title: Global Medical Collaboration Leader (Gmcl) - Fixed-Term Contract
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression open dialogue and genuine connections where you are valued accepted and respected for who you are allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. Its what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. Thats what makes us Roche!

The Opportunity

The Global Medical Collaboration Leader (GMCL) is a medical global field-based role working across countries and affiliates to accelerate the development and delivery of medicines to patients through effective medical customer engagement across the lifecycle of a molecule / Disease Area (DA).

There are two available positions : Neuroscience and Obesity.

Responsibilities
  1. Develops and facilitates relationships and collaborative networks with external stakeholders ensuring Roche is the preferred partner and championing a ONE Roche approach. Drives scientific knowledge exchange with global experts and across scientific networks at global and affiliate level. Establishes and maintains scientific collaborations with key external stakeholders (including patient organisations scientific societies academia policy and access stakeholders). Identifies and progresses key opportunities for increased collaboration and cooperation and overcomes barriers to facilitate collaborations between customers and the organisation.
  2. Engages and educates investigators and site staff to enable and expedite the successful delivery of clinical development programmes. Drives scientific engagement with clinical trial sites to support patient recruitment and retention by ensuring confidence and motivation of site staff across the development programme(s). Gathers investigator feedback and insights to optimise clinical development performance and customer experience. Discusses and supports IISs compassionate use programmes and data strategies that support access activities (until release of pivotal data).
  3. Provides real-time insights and ground level understanding of the disease area landscape across countries to better inform cross-functional strategies. Builds a comprehensive understanding of the local environment. Executes insights gathering activities to address knowledge gaps (including advisory boards steering committees etc). Ensures the customer perspective is incorporated in strategic and tactical decisions.
  4. Partners with global cross‑functional colleagues and affiliates to enhance launch readiness in assigned countries. Accelerates affiliate understanding of the disease area ecosystem and supports understanding and alignment with the global strategy to drive effective affiliate planning and decision making. Acts as disease area champion and advocate in the assigned affiliates. Supports the local implementation of field‑based activities of the global medical plan in compliance with all local requirements.
  5. Contributes to the high performance and innovation of the Global Medical Collaboration community to optimise customer experience and to evolve to meet the needs of the organisation.
Qualifications

Who you are :

  • Required: University degree in science or related field.
  • Highly desirable: Postgraduate degree (PhD, PharmD, MSc, MD, MBA).
  • At least 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry or related industries in a global or affiliate role.
  • At least 2 years of experience in a medical / scientific customer-facing field role.
  • Desired: Deep scientific knowledge / experience in Neuroscience (especially Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases).
  • Experience in Medical Affairs Product Development or Early Development is essential including understanding and experience of processes and procedures for clinical trial engagement for corporate sponsored and independent supported studies.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
  • Fluency in written and spoken Portuguese (Brazilian) is mandatory.
  • Highly desirable: fluency in Spanish.
  • Passion for Customer Centricity and External Medical Engagement.
  • Strategic skills and system awareness are critical for this role liaising with teams within Global Medical Affairs Global Product Development Global Research & Early Development and Global Commercial functions and country affiliates.
  • Flexibility and scientific agility to change between disease areas functional and / or specialist topics according to business needs.

2‑year fixed‑term contract.

No relocation budget available for this position.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together more than employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities foster creativity and keep our ambitions high so we can deliver life‑changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Lets build a healthier future together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Endocrinologista - Clinica Bemol Saúde
description:
Overview

O Endocrinologista da Clínica Bemol é responsável por diagnosticar, tratar e acompanhar pacientes com distúrbios hormonais e metabólicos, promovendo a saúde integral de forma ética, acolhedora e centrada no cliente. Atua com base nos princípios de qualidade, integridade, empatia e melhoria contínua, alinhado à cultura organizacional da Bemol.

A Bemol é uma empresa de prestação de serviços e comercialização de produtos no varejo, que tem como principal objetivo a busca da satisfação de nossos Clientes, observando o processo de melhoria contínua, legislação externa aplicável, princípios e valores culturais da organização, sendo esses princípios Integridade, Respeito, Economia, Energia e Melhoria Continua.

Responsabilidades
  • Avaliar pacientes com suspeita de alterações endócrinas, realizando diagnóstico clínico, físico e solicitando exames complementares, quando necessário.
  • Prescrever tratamentos adequados às condições diagnosticadas, considerando as diretrizes clínicas atualizadas e protocolos internos.
  • Acompanhar a evolução clínica dos pacientes em consultas regulares, promovendo educação em saúde e adesão terapêutica.
  • Registrar todas as informações e condutas médicas nos sistemas corporativos da Clínica Bemol, garantindo precisão e sigilo profissional.
  • Atuar em conformidade com os princípios do Código de Ética da Bemol e da medicina, assegurando um atendimento humanizado e seguro.
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas, treinamentos internos e ações de melhoria da qualidade assistencial promovidas pela Bemol.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em fisiologia e patologias do sistema endócrino.
  • Capacidade de interpretar exames laboratoriais e de imagem relacionados à endocrinologia.
  • Domínio de condutas clínicas baseadas em evidências.
  • Experiência no uso de prontuário eletrônico e sistemas de saúde digital.
  • Atualização constante com diretrizes de sociedades médicas nacionais/internacionais.
Qualificações
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Medicina com residência médica ou especialização em Endocrinologia reconhecida pelo MEC e/ou Sociedade Brasileira de Endocrinologia e Metabologia
  • Experiência em atendimento ambulatorial especializado em endocrinologia. Desejável atuação prévia em serviços voltados à atenção integral e humanizada à saúde.
  • Inscrição;
  • Questionário Cultural do RH;
  • Prova de Português;
  • Teste Não Verbal de Inteligência;

Nós da Bemol, respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valorização das diferenças (ex: Gênero, Religião, PCD, LGBTQ+, Raça e Etnia). Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso.

A Bemol foi fundada em 13 de agosto de 1942 pelos irmãos Samuel, Israel e Saul Benchimol. Nos primeiros anos, atuou no comércio de medicamentos, passando posteriormente para cereais, cimento e, por fim, eletrodomésticos, ramo em que atuamos até os dias de hoje. Com o tempo, a Bemol se consolidou como uma empresa moderna, ágil e referência em quase todos os segmentos em que atua: eletroeletrônicos, eletrodomésticos, móveis, autoatendimento, farmacêuticos, materiais de construção, alimentos, entre outros.

Hoje contamos com mais de 37 lojas físicas , 1 loja online e 6 centros de distribuição , localizados em Manaus, Porto Velho e Rio Branco. Sempre prezando pelo atendimento e serviços de qualidade, a Bemol também conta com 22 loterias em suas lojas e 5 unidades do Mercado Bemol em Manaus.

Em 2016, a Bemol expandiu sua atuação na área da saúde com a inauguração da Bemol Farma , que atualmente possui 47 unidades físicas e 1 loja online. Para complementar essa frente, também contamos com uma unidade da Clínica Bemol Saúde .

Atualmente, somos cerca de 5 mil colaboradores , e seguimos em constante expansão. Buscamos profissionais que sejam apaixonados pelo que fazem, que tenham persistência, criatividade, agilidade e vontade de crescer junto com a Bemol.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão.

Nosso compromisso é promover uma cultura de inclusão da diversidade, que capacita nossos colaboradores a contribuir com o seu melhor. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas, sem distinção de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade e/ou expressão de gênero, idade, raça, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

A SPDM é uma empregadora de igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todas as pessoas que assim atendam os requisitos mínimos.

Valorizamos o compartilhamento de ideias, o desenvolvimento de uma cultura de trabalho em equipe, respeito a diversidade e inclusão.

MISSÃO

Atuar com excelência na atenção à saúde sem preconceito, distinção ou classificação dos cidadãos.

VISÃO

Ser reconhecida como organização filantrópica brasileira em saúde de maior abrangência e competência.

- Capacitação

-Confiabilidade

-Equidade

-Humanização

-Qualidade

-Sustentabilidade ecológica, econômica e social

-Tradição

O Hospital Regional de Sorocaba “Dr. Adib Domingos Jatene”, destaca-se pelo atendimento e leva o que há de mais avançado em conhecimento médico até a comunidade, buscando uma saúde pública digna, com qualidade e compromisso social, sendo referência para a população de Sorocaba em aproximadamente 659.871 habitantes. O HRS atenderá a região da DRSXVI Sorocaba (48 municípios) e 15 municípios das Regiões de Saúde de Mananciais e Rota dos Bandeirantes, totalizando uma população de 5.412.200 habitantes (IBGE – 2016), através da Central de Regulação de Serviços de Saúde do Estado de São Paulo.

O Hospital Regional de Sorocaba “Dr. Adib Domingos Jatene”, conta com leitos clínicos adulto, cirúrgicos, pediátricos, centro cirúrgico, centro de diagnóstico, pronto atendimento e ambulatório de especialidades, além de uma unidade de cirurgia ambulatorial, onde são realizadas cirurgias eletivas, com internação e alta no mesmo dia do procedimento.

O atendimento é realizado por uma equipe multiprofissional qualificada, que atua com o objetivo de proporcionar o melhor atendimento a nossos pacientes, prestando serviços com humanização.

Sobre a CASSI

A CASSI foi fundada em 27 de janeiro de por um grupo de funcionários do BB, com o objetivo de ressarcir as despesas de saúde dessa população.

Nestas oito décadas, a Empresa experimentou grande desenvolvimento, tornando-se uma das maiores instituições sem fins lucrativos administradoras de planos de saúde do País.

As 27 Unidades, instaladas em todos os Estados do País, proporcionam atendimento acolhedor e diferenciado.

O diferencial da Caixa de Assistência está na proposta de atendimento integral, focado na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, por meio da Estratégia Saúde da Família.

Assim, é pioneira entre os planos de saúde brasileiros na oferta de programas e atividades coletivas em saúde, voltados para melhoria dos hábitos de vida, nutrição, atividade física, realização de consultas periódicas e exames de rotina, além de proporcionar o acompanhamento adequado dos portadores de doenças crônicas.

Somos guiados por valores como base científica, performance, agilidade e paixão. Esses valores impulsionam nosso trabalho diário e nos permitem construir relacionamentos duradouros com cirurgiões-dentistas, pacientes, professores e pesquisadores pelo Brasil e no exterior.

Acreditamos no poder de transformar o sorriso e buscamos melhorar a vida das pessoas através de nossos produtos. Essa é a nossa missão e compromisso, que também se estende aos nossos colaboradores, pois somos uma equipe unida há quase três décadas, oferecendo as melhores soluções no campo da odontologia estética e implantodontia.

Juntos, somos a FGM, transformando sorrisos e fazendo a diferença na área odontológica.

Venha fazer parte da Família FGM e transforme você também vidas através de Sorrisos!

Como se candidatar:

  • Envie seu currículo e breve apresentação para com o assunto "Vaga Setor Orçamentos"

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

title: Director, Hematology Medical Engagement Lead (Mel) Intercontinental Region
description:
Working with Us Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high‑achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: careers.Bms.Com/working-with-us.

A BMS acredita que ter uma equipe diversificada de funcionários e uma cultura de inclusão é vital para a inovação e para executar de forma bem-sucedida nossa estratégia de negócios BioPharma. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD), assim como para as demais dimensões no sentido mais amplo da diversidade, como gênero, idade, etnia, raça, orientação sexual & identidades, habilidades físicas, aparência, religião, origem socioeconômica, estilos de pensamento e experiências de vida.

Role Overview

The primary role of MEL is to engage in meaningful peer‑to‑peer scientific dialog with healthcare system Regional/International Thought Leaders (RTLs) within Intercontinental Region Countries (mainly Brazil, Latin America including Puerto Rico, Canada, Turkey, KSA&Gulf and Israel). The MEL conducts critical activities that support advancing science, educating on evolving clinical practices, transforming science into patient care, and facilitating the development of new research collaborations (including Collaborative and Investigator‑led Trials and Real‑World Evidence). The role collaborates with colleagues on capturing medical insights and acts as a therapeutic area resource to cross‑functional partners. Engagement with TLs should be aligned with medical strategies, and the role should provide insight back to home office/global teams to inform regional and global strategy.

This role is field‑based and regional in scope. It is anticipated that the employee will spend ~ 50 to 70% of the time in the field interacting with external stakeholders, including investigators and clinical thought leaders while supporting internal stakeholders and maintaining a high level of therapeutic expertise.

External Scientific Exchange & Medical Strategy Advisory
  • Engaging in high-quality peer-to-peer scientific dialog with key Intercontinental Thought Leaders (TLs) in Hematology focused on pre- and peri-launch period.
  • Collaborates with Intercontinental Thought Leaders to identify and generate insights on evolving care paradigms to inform medical strategy.
  • Provides strategic input into education and communication materials, including conference symposia.
  • Provides strategic input into regional access and reimbursement strategy.
  • Serves as subject matter expert for internal education for key strategic team members of GPT and other governance bodies, commercialization cross-functional teams, WW medical team and Local Medical Teams.
  • Whenever needed support the regional clinical trial execution strategy especially for the priority trials.
Evidence Facilitation
  • Facilitates scientific partnerships and research collaborations with Global and Local medical teams, and other WW functions such as the Global Development Team (GDD).
  • Provides recommendations and insights to the clinical development team on study feasibilities and site selection within the therapeutic area based on knowledge of the field and through direct contacts with potential investigators, as agreed with home office medical and Global Development Operations (GDO).
  • Provides recommendations and insights to build best evidence generation plan to address specific regional gaps (incl. access and reimbursement needs).
  • Proactively discusses BMS major evidence readouts to investigators partnering with GDD. Reactively discuss major evidence readouts with other thought‑leaders.
  • Liaises with Hematology experts and centers to understand clinical levers and barriers to patient access in the context of clinical trials and upon commercial availability of the product.
Medical Engagement
  • Effectively collaborates and communicates with Intercontinental Thought Leaders to gain insights into the clinical landscape.
  • Engages in scientific and clinical conversation to ensure the development of a product/disease area-focused medical plan that translates into effective launch and Life Cycle Maintenance (LCM) activities.
  • Responsible for conducting evidence read‑outs with the most prominent institutions, e.G., pivotal top‑line data.

A Salvador Caetano é um grupo internacional presente em 3 continentes, com mais de 75 anos dedicados à indústria e setor automóvel. Emprega mais de 8000 pessoas, em mais de 43 países.

Na Salvador Caetano criamos valor nos nossos negócios, sempre de olhos postos no futuro e reafirmando o compromisso de manter sólidas as relações que fomos construindo, ao longo dos anos, com os nossos colaboradores, parceiros e clientes. Como é Ser Diretor/a de Marketing?

Como Diretor/a de Marketing irás liderar toda a estratégia e execução de marketing para o lançamento e crescimento da marca em Portugal, garantindo notoriedade, consistência e impacto no mercado.

  • Estratégia & Liderança:
    • Definir a estratégia global de Marketing da marca em Portugal, alinhada com a visão do grupo e do mercado;

    • Construir e fazer evoluir o departamento de Marketing da marca a par do crescimento da marca (equipa, processos, prioridades);
    • Desenvolver campanhas multicanal: digital, performance, social media, ATL, BTL, relações públicas e eventos;
    • Garantir a presença da marca em feiras, ativações, roadshows e ações com concessionários.
  • Gestão de Stakeholders & Orçamento:
    • Gerir o orçamento de marketing com rigor e visão estratégica;
    • Trabalhar diretamente com a Direção Comercial, After‑sales e Rede de Concessionários;

  • Análise & Performance:

    • Definir e monitorizar KPIs, assegurando reporting regular;
    • Otimizar as ações de marketing com base em dados, garantindo eficiência e impacto.

  • Experiência:

    • Excelentes competências de comunicação, liderança e gestão de stakeholders;

  • Projeto diferenciador: construção e lançamento de uma marca automóvel nova em Portugal;

Realizar atendimento médico dentro da especialidade de cardiologia, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde de São Paulo e protocolos existentes. Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;
Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino;
Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Graduação completa em medicina. CRM ativo no estado de atuação com inscrição mínima de 24 meses.

Necessário residência médica oficial em alguma especialidade compatível com o serviço.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.
