title: Head Of Partnerships, Brazil
description:
Location: São Paulo (remote working)

Substack is building a new global economic engine for culture, giving the most creative and interesting people on the internet the power of their own publishing platform. Substack’s model—based on direct subscriptions—has fueled an explosion of independent publishing, empowering creators with economic autonomy, creative ownership, and a direct connection to their most engaged audiences.

We’re hiring a Head of Creator Partnerships for Brazil to lead and scale the Brazilian Substack business. Working alongside our Head of Europe, you’ll be responsible for building awareness of the Substack brand in Brazil, onboarding the country’s most exciting independent talent, as well as helping to tell the Substack story to creators and consumers across the country.

This is a pivotal role for an exceptional leader who has a strong track record of business growth as well as nurturing creative talent across all mediums. You’ll also be a strategic thinker who is as comfortable working with big political names as you are smaller less well known creators. Knowledge of events and being comfortable speaking publicly is a bonus.

What You’ll Do:

  1. With the help of Substack’s Head of Europe you’ll develop and execute a strategy for onboarding influential creators, helping them build successful subscription businesses and vibrant communities on Substack.

  2. Own key growth metrics around creator acquisition, retention, revenue, and engagement—aligning impact with Substack’s broader business goals.

  3. Build and deepen relationships with creators, talent managers, studios, agencies, tastemakers to the press to expand Substack’s presence in the cultural ecosystem.

  4. Champion Brazilian creators internally by synthesizing their needs, motivations, and ambitions into product, support, and partnership opportunities.

  5. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data, Marketing, and Communications to evolve the Spanish creator experience and improve outreach and feature adoption.

  6. Represent Substack externally—on stage, in the press, and in key industry rooms—positioning the company as the premier platform for independent creative work.

  7. Stay ahead of creator economy trends, emerging formats, and shifting audience behaviors to keep Substack on the leading edge in Brazil.

What We’re Looking For:

  1. 7+ years of experience as a leader in creator partnerships, talent development, business development or editorial

  2. Proven success leading and scaling teams in fast-paced environments with high agency and ownership.

  3. Deep empathy for creators and an understanding of the challenges and opportunities they face when building independent careers.

  4. A robust network across the creator economy—including relationships with top creators, talent agencies, production companies, digital media leaders and journalists

  5. A demonstrable and exceptional understanding of the Brazilian ‘creator’ market

  6. An ability to communicate clearly and effectively often on a public stage is a bonus.

Substack’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, and exceptional benefits. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Substack is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or transgender status), age, national origin, veteran or disability status. We’re seeking people passionate about enabling independent expression and building a better business model for creators. If you want to see what media, communities, and content can become when unmoored from advertising models, and you have the skills and experience to contribute, we’d love to meet you.

A Onfly é uma startup focada em ajudar as empresas a viajarem melhor!

Democratizar a gestão de viagens, reembolsos, descontos em passagens, hotéis e locação de carros em uma experiência completa e simples é foco do nosso negócio.

Somos um dos melhores lugares para se trabalhar no Brasil (inclusive somos uma das empresas do Great Place to work)!

Para que alcancemos a meta de crescer exponencialmente, buscamos pessoas que sejam apaixonadas por tecnologia, que desejam estar em um time de alta performance e que queiram crescer muuuuito.

Para a vaga de Consultor de Viagens Pleno buscamos um profissional que será responsável por prestar uma consultoria de viagens com informações sobre diferentes destinos turísticos vendidos pela agência, cuidar do atendimento ao cliente de forma multicanal (por telefone, chat e e-mail). Realizar a emissão de passagens aéreas, reserva de hotéis e carros.

Disponibilidade para trabalhar 11:00 às 20:00

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades da vaga:

  • Atendimento ao cliente via multicanais;
  • Emissão e remarcação de passagens, aquisição de serviços junto às companhias (assento, bagagens), contato com hotéis e locadoras;
  • Perfil de clientes e atendimento de grande porte;
  • Participar de atendimento dedicado, serviços de concierge, identificar problemas e formular hipóteses de soluções;
  • Reconhecer GDS,participar de cotação, conhecimento em excel, arbitrar de forma técnica a melhor decisão escolhida pelo cliente;
  • Participar de reuniões com clientes, reportar indicadores e melhores práticas, controle de SLA.
Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

  • Residir em SÃO PAULO ou região metropolitana;
  • Regime 100% presencial;
  • Formação em Turismo ou áreas relacionadas (adm, engenharia de produção entre outros);
  • Experiência em agências de viagens ou outras empresas de travel;
  • Excel básico;
  • Conhecimento básico de sistemas de reservas (GDS), como Amadeus;
  • Habilidade paralidar com ferramentas de CRM e plataformas de gestão de viagens.
Additional information

Benefícios de ser um Onflyer

  • Vale refeição em cartão flexível R$41,75 (sem desconto de 6%);

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco, sem coparticipação e sem mensalidade para o Onflyer (por nossa conta);

  • Desconto Farmácia;

  • Benefícios de academia (WellHub);
  • Bolsa de 90% para estudos de idiomas;
  • Descontos em Graduações e Pós-graduações (UAM e USJT);
  • Descontos em Graduações e Pós-graduações;

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company – Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Hi…
My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go!
Running Tours.
This is not your usual job post.
Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go!
Running Tours.
Maybe no one will reply.
Maybe many will.
I just need one really good one!
So let's start. Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients.

Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that – if you are a runner and marketeer – probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You'll be working on a newsletter and pling!

  • An email lands in your inbox from Brooks, or Lululemon, or Abbott World Marathon Majors.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà: now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more… right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously. And have loads of fun with it.

I personally love testing new ideas, so know that you'll have me and colleagues from all over the world cheering you on every step of the way. You'll also own our digital advertising efforts: planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. Requisitos e Qualificações
  • Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e Propaganda, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, Especializações, MBAs ou mestrados na área de Marketing e Comunicação.
  • Experiência com marketing de performance, com habilidade para interpretar dados e métricas.
  • Vivência sólida na área de marketing, atuando com branding gestão de marca.
O que oferecemos
  • Alimentação com liberdade e escolha – Um cartão flexível pra você decidir onde e como se alimentar, sem desconto em folha.
  • Vale-Transporte ou Combustível – Para facilitar seu deslocamento, do jeito que fizer mais sentido pra você, sem desconto em folha.

  • Day Off de Aniversário – Seu novo ciclo merece pausa, presença e celebração.

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.
  • Contribute to chatbot proof-of-concept development by providing data insights and supporting testing activities.


Business Systems Analyst | Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, reporting analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Proficient in writing SQL queries for data investigation and analysis.
  • Hands-on experience modifying and troubleshooting Tableau dashboards and working with backend data sources.
  • Skilled in managing issues in Jira and working across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
  • Familiarity with navigating Salesforce and SAP for data verification (no development or admin experience required).

Join to apply for the Associate - Medical Science Liaison (MSL) Cardiometabolismo - região NE - sede Salvador role at Eli Lilly and Company .

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life‑changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Purpose of the Role (Proposito do Trabalho)

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field‑based medical affairs professional with deep knowledge about specific diseases and treatments, products available and compounds in investigation (both at Lilly and competitors), as well as detailed knowledge about research, regulatory affairs and medical education, and related processes. The primary activity of the MSL is to engage specialists (scientific experts) and others in the medical community to understand external research, clinical needs, respond to spontaneous questions, and foster a two‑way scientific dialogue. Scientific Experts are individuals recognized for their expertise in a specific area and therefore have special needs for in‑depth, up‑to‑date information because they develop and implement research and educate colleagues and students. By providing answers and facilitating communication between industry and the scientific experts community, the MSL has the opportunity to improve patient outcomes through the necessary information that addresses important clinical and scientific questions.

Principal Responsibilities (Principais Responsabilidades)
  • Engage with Scientific Experts to answer their questions.
  • Gather, analyze and share clinical insights and scientific intelligence.
  • Develop and execute initiatives for continuing medical education.
  • Facilitate research opportunities and medical education activities.
Profile of the Work (Perfil do Trabalho)
  • Currently pursuing a health‑related bachelor’s degree (Medicine, Biology, Nursing, Physical Therapy, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, or Nutrition).
  • Post‑graduation (master’s or doctoral) is desirable.
  • Experience in cardiometabolismo is desirable.
  • Prior experience as an MSL, medical educator, or in other pharmaceutical industry roles is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to build professional relationships and network.
  • Intellectual curiosity about the science/medicine that is responsible for (Metabolism).
  • High motivation and the capacity to comprehend large amounts of scientific content and communicate it clearly and concisely.
  • Presentation skills – expertise in critical analysis of scientific articles.
  • Ability to meet client needs for complex information.
  • Managing priorities and projects involving multiple areas.
  • Ability to work effectively and share information with a team.
  • Familiarity with the academic community, clinical research, and medical education.
Other Information (Outras Informações)
  • Requirement for national/domestic travel availability.
  • Possession of a valid category B driver’s license.
  • Mobility to relocate to Salvador.

description:
Overview

At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.

Posição MSL - preferência de sede: Salvador

PROPÓSITO DO TRABALHO

Medical Science Liaison (MSL) é um profissional de medical affairs baseado no campo com profundo conhecimento sobre doenças e tratamentos específicos, produtos disponíveis e compostos em investigação (tanto na Lilly como competidores), assim como detalhado conhecimento sobre pesquisa, assuntos regulatórios e educação médica, além dos processos relacionados. A principal atividade do MSL é engajar especialistas (scientific experts) e outros na comunidade médica para entender pesquisa externa, necessidades clínicas, responder questões espontaneamente solicitadas e fomentar um diálogo científico de duas vias. Scientific Experts são indivíduos que são reconhecidos por sua expertise numa área específica e como tais, têm necessidades especiais relacionadas a informações aprofundadas e atualizadas porque eles desenvolvem e implementam pesquisas e educam colegas e estudantes. Provendo respostas e facilitando a comunicação científica entre a indústria e a comunidade de Scientific Experts, o MSL tem a oportunidade de melhorar os desfechos dos pacientes através da informação necessária que direciona importantes questões clínicas e científicas.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES
  • Responder às questões dos Scientific Experts.
  • Reunir, analisar e compartilhar insights clínicos e inteligência científica.
  • Desenvolver e executar iniciativas de educação médica continuada.
  • Facilitar oportunidades de pesquisa e de atividades de educação médica.
PERFIL DO TRABALHO
  • Graduação em curso da área da saúde requerida (Medicina, Biologia, Enfermagem, Fisioterapia, Biomedicina, Farmácia ou Nutrição).
  • Pós-graduação como mestrado ou doutorado desejável.
  • Experiência prévia em cardiometabolismo desejável.
  • Experiência prévia como MSL, educador médico, ou em outra área da indústria farmacêutica será diferencial.
  • Proficiência em inglês (falado e escrito).
  • Importantes habilidades interpessoais, incluindo capacidade de engajar em relacionamentos profissionais, além de networking.
  • Curiosidade intelectual a respeito da área da ciência/ Medicina pela qual é responsável (Metabolismo).
  • Alta motivação e capacidade de compreender grande quantidade de conteúdo científico que então será comunicado de forma clara e concisa.
  • Habilidades de apresentação – expertise em análise crítica de artigos científicos.
  • Atender necessidades de clientes em relação a informações complexas.
  • Manejar prioridades e projetos envolvendo múltiplas áreas.
  • Habilidade em trabalhar efetivamente e compartilhar informações com uma equipe.
  • Familiaridade com comunidade acadêmica, pesquisa clínica e educação médica.
OUTRAS INFORMAÇÕES
  • Necessidade de disponibilidade para viagens nacionais/domésticas.
  • Possuir CNH categoria B válida.
  • Mobilidade para fixar residência em Salvador.

title: Senior Sap Consultant
description:
Role

SAP SD Consultant

Location

Brazil (Remote)

Mode

Full Time

Required To Travel once a Month to the work Location at Alagoinhas, Bahia (manufacturing plant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in local tax and regulatory requirements, including NF-e and Nota Fiscal processes, and experience integrating SAP SD with other core modules. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English, hands‑on configuration skills, and the ability to adapt to evolving tax and business environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, configure, and implement SAP SD processes in SAP ECC, adapting the global template to meet Brazilian statutory, tax, and regulatory needs.
  • Handle Brazil‑specific localization, including e‑invoicing (NF‑e), fiscal documents (nota fiscal), new tax reform changes and CFOP determination.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws on sales, including ICMS, IPI, PIS / COFINS, and configure related tax calculations and posting rules.
  • Work on integrations between SAP SD and other modules like MM and FI, especially for logistics and tax postings.
  • Partner with ABAP developers to develop and test functional specifications for custom enhancements (RICEFW).
  • Manage multiple work assignments, support project rollout phases, and adapt to new tax laws and regulations.
  • Provide cutover and hypercare support after go‑live.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 8-10 years of experience in SAP SD, with a focus on Brazilian localization.
  • Deep knowledge of Brazilian SAP localization, including e‑transformation and e‑document requirements.
  • Experience in SAP ECC implementation and deployment projects is a plus.
  • Familiarity with other modules like MM and FI is beneficial.
  • Fluency in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong analytical, problem‑solving, verbal, and written communication skills.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. SAP SD Consultant

Brazil (Remote)

Full Time

once a month to the work location at Alagoinhas, Bahia (manufacturing plant)

We are seeking an experienced SAP SD Consultant specializing in Brazilian localization to support configuration, implementation, and compliance within SAP ECC.

Este é um papel sênior, estratégico e hands‑on, ideal para alguém que thrive com execução orientada a resultados, capaz de escalar campanhas em social pago, search, programático e influenciadores, enquanto garante alinhamento com criativo, social e PR para maximizar crescimento e ROI.

  • Garantir volume alto de criativos prontos para teste toda semana.

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. I wanted to give you a good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with us.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

Other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voila: now you nailed it. Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners from all over the world. We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more.

Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities, testing an initiative in one city and scaling it, researching new tech and trends. Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimizing flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, this is your playground.

You'll also own our digital advertising efforts: planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what moves the needle. You’ll create case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you're never left alone.

Contract Details
  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hours a week
  • Managed via Upwork

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.

Most important traits: fast mover, super collaborator, drive to grow the business and yourself, and – the most important skill of all – execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

To apply, please write to me via email at ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours (no AI please – we want to know the real you).

Additional Information
  • Seniority level: Entry level
  • Employment type: Part‑time
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales
  • Industries: Travel Arrangements
  • Referrals increase your chances of interviewing by 2x

title: Head De Marketing
description:
O Head de Marketing será o cérebro estratégico por trás do crescimento da marca, responsável por impulsionar a geração de demanda, posicionar a empresa no hype do mercado e criar conexões reais com clientes, parceiros e comunidade.

Vai liderar o jogo entre performance e branding, unindo dados, criatividade e relacionamento para transformar awareness em resultado.

O foco é claro: escalar o negócio, fortalecer o posicionamento e gerar leads qualificados no ecossistema B2B.

Atividades:
  • Planejar e executar estratégias de crescimento (Growth): mapear oportunidades, testar hipóteses e otimizar o funil de aquisição e retenção;
  • Fortalecer o branding: construir uma identidade de marca sólida, moderna e coerente com os valores da empresa;

  • Atuar junto ao time comercial: alinhar estratégias de marketing e vendas para gerar leads qualificados e fortalecer o pipeline B2B;
  • Desenvolver parcerias estratégicas: criar relações com empresas, influenciadores e comunidades que ampliem o alcance da marca;
  • Analisar resultados e métricas: acompanhar indicadores de performance (CAC, LTV, ROI, tráfego, leads, engajamento) e propor melhorias;
  • Gerir pessoas efornecedores: coordenar equipe interna e parceiros externos com foco em entrega, qualidade e inovação;
  • Conduzir lançamentos e campanhas Go-to-Market: estruturar e posicionar novos produtos ou soluções no mercado;
  • Manter a marca em movimento: acompanhar tendências, novas ferramentas e inovações que garantam relevância e competitividade.
Requisitos:
  • Formação superior completa em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em posições de liderança em marketing com foco em crescimento e performance;
  • Domínio em estratégias de Growth Marketing, Inbound, SEO, Mídia Paga, Social Media e Branding;
  • Vivência em negócios B2B, preferencialmente em empresas de serviços;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e transformar métricas em planos de ação;
  • Perfil criativo, comunicativo e orientado a resultados;
  • Habilidade em construir e nutrir relacionamentos estratégicos e parcerias;
  • Conhecimento emferramentas de automação, CRM e análise de dados (ex: RD Station, HubSpot, Google Analytics, Power BI);
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado será considerado diferencial.

description:
Oportunidades de Carreira: Médico Intensivista Pediátrico - Hospital Central de Alta Complexidade de Mato Grosso - Cuiabá - MT )

Com mais de 60 anos de existência, a Sociedade Beneficente Israelita Brasileira Albert Einstein ainda mantém uma premissa: inovar e crescer, sempre com excelência. Ajudamos a salvar vidas, difundir o conhecimento em educação, prevenção e inovação em saúde. Além da atuação em setores assistenciais, temos oportunidades na área de Inovação, Tecnologia, Pesquisa, Ensino, entre outras. Seguimos oferecendo qualidade, afirmando nosso compromisso com a Responsabilidade Social e com o propósito de levar uma gota de Einstein para cada cidadão. Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão de todos os talentos e buscamos profissionais que compartilhem deste mesmo propósito!

Unidade: Hospital Central de Alta Complexidade de Mato Grosso - Cuiabá - MT

Modelo de Trabalho: PJ

Responsabilidades
  • Participar diretamente no atendimento a pacientes, executando intervenções médicas, realizando o processo de admissão e alta, participando na decisão da conduta a ser tomada para o paciente, bem como realizando atividades de: assistência intensiva (multidisciplinar), documentação, registro de evolução, prescrição e bolet médico, visitando e examinando pacientes, recebimento e passagem de plantão, supervisão do atendimento a familiares;
  • Contribuir paraalta qualidade na prestação dos serviços do departamento, através da execução de políticas, processos operacionais, normas, procedimentos e padrões de rotina (guias clínicos e protocolos de conduta) dentro de uma subespecialidade (caso a tenha) e, ocasionalmente apoiando estas atividades;
  • Interagir com otime assistencial junto às discussões para o melhor cuidado ao paciente;
  • Participar das atividades internas da UTI no que concerne a atualização, reuniões administrativas e da sua especialidade;
  • Conuir no alinhamento do departamento às diretrizes gerais da instituição, dando apoio e participando em auditoria interna da qualidade e em certificações técnicas etc.
  • Auxiliar nas análises, assim como promover melhorias contínuas, em eventos adversos;
  • Aderir às políticas institucionais e participar dos treinamentos obrigatórios;
  • Promover o ensino das melhores práticas e postura comportamental ética para alunos e residentes inseridos no acompanhamento de seus cuidados.
Requisitos
  • Superior em Medicina e CRM ativo;
  • Residência em Terapia Intensiva Pediátrica e Título da Especialidade (AMIB/AMB);
  • Experiência comprovada na área.
Desejável
  • Curso PALS (Pediatrics Advanced Life Support).
Requisitos Para Contratação
  • CNPJ ativo: A empresa deverá possuir CNPJ ativo e estar em situação regular junto à Receita Federal.
  • O médico contratado deverá ser sócio da empresa, constando devidamente no quadro societário da Pessoa Jurídica.
  • Regularidade Fiscal e Trabalhista: É necessário que a empresa esteja em dia com suas obrigações tributárias e trabalhistas, apresentando as seguintes certidões válidas: Certidão Negativa de Débitos Estaduais da Dívida Ativa, Certidão Negativa de Débitos Trabalhistas, Certidão de Débitos Relativos a Créditos Tributários Federais e à Dívida Ativa da União, Certidão de Débitos Tributários Estaduais e Certificado de Regularidade do FGTS.
  • Registro no Conselho de Medicina (CRM): A empresa deverá estar devidamente inscrita e regularizada junto ao Conselho Regional de Medicina, apresentando o Certificado de Regularidade de Inscrição de Pessoa Jurídica.
  • CNAE compatível com a atividade médica: A empresa deverá possuir, em seu cadastro na Receita Federal, um ou mais dos CNAEs abaixo, compatíveis com a prestação de serviços médicos: 8630-5/01, 8630-5/02, 8630-5/03, 8610-1/20 e 8630-5/99.
  • Conta bancária Pessoa Jurídica: A empresa deverá possuir conta bancária vinculada ao CNPJ, em nome da própria pessoa jurídica.
Etapas Do Processo Seletivo
  • Avaliação curricular;
  • Prova teórica (online);
  • Entrevista com comitê formado especificamente para o processo seletivo.
Prazo de inscrições

Inscreva-se até 21/12/2025.

description:
Mais de 35 anos democratizando a saúde de qualidade

Com mais de 35 anos de história, a Clínica Fares oferece atendimento humanizado em mais de 40 especialidades médicas, com consultas, exames, procedimentos e cirurgias, tudo em um único local, garantindo praticidade e agilidade para nossos pacientes.

Por que escolher a Clínica Fares?

Impacto Real: Faça parte de uma equipe de 250+ médicos e 400+ profissionais que já transformaram mais de 1 milhão de vidas.

Infraestrutura Moderna: Nossos polos médicos de 2.500m² proporcionam uma infraestrutura completa e tecnologia de ponta, oferecendo conforto e excelência em cada atendimento.

Crescimento Profissional: Perspectivas reais de carreira em uma empresa em constante expansão, presente nas zonas Norte, Sul, Leste e Oeste da Grande São Paulo.

Reconhecimento: Salários competitivos e plano de carreira.

Junte-se a nós

Se você busca fazer parte de uma equipe dedicada, com propósito e inovação, venha para a Clínica Fares. Transforme a saúde de milhares de pessoas enquanto constrói uma carreira extraordinária.

Clínica Fares - Onde talentos excepcionais constroem carreiras extraordinárias.

Registro e Ética Profissional
  • Manter prontuários médicos atualizados, com registros claros e detalhados, conforme normas do CFM e diretrizes da Clínica Fares.
  • Atuar de forma ética, segura e baseada em evidências.
Atendimento Humanizado
  • Promover acolhimento e escuta ativa, considerando aspectos emocionais, sociais e culturais dos pacientes.
  • Estabelecer vínculo de confiança e corresponsabilidade com o paciente no processo terapêutico.
Responsabilidades do Médico Endocrinologista – Clínica Fares Atendimento Clínico Especializado
  • Realizar consultas ambulatoriais com foco na prevenção, diagnóstico, tratamento e controle de distúrbios hormonais e metabólicos.
  • Avaliar e acompanhar casos como:
  • Diabetes mellitus (tipo 1, tipo 2 e gestacional)
  • Obesidade e síndrome metabólica
  • Distúrbios da tireoide (hipotireoidismo, hipertireoidismo, nódulos)
  • Distúrbios da hipófise e suprarrenal
  • Osteoporose e alterações do metabolismo ósseo
  • Hiperlipidemia, dislipidemias e alterações do colesterol
  • Distúrbios hormonais da puberdade, crescimento, menopausa e andropausa
Interpretação de Exames
  • Solicitar e interpretar exames laboratoriais e de imagem relacionados à função endócrina (TSH, T4, cortisol, insulina, hemoglobina glicada, densitometria óssea, entre outros).
  • Acompanhar evolução de marcadores laboratoriais com foco em controle metabólico e prevenção de complicações.
Tratamento e Planejamento Terapêutico
  • Prescrever tratamentos medicamentosos e orientar mudanças no estilo de vida, com ênfase em educação em saúde, nutrição e atividade física.
  • Ajustar condutas terapêuticas com base em protocolos atualizados e individualização do cuidado.
Acompanhamento Contínuo
  • Realizar o seguimento de pacientes crônicos, promovendo adesão ao tratamento e redução de riscos.
  • Avaliar resposta a terapias hormonais e intervenções clínicas.
Atuação Multidisciplinar
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com outras especialidades (nutrologia, cardiologia, ginecologia, nefrologia, geriatria, psicologia e nutrição).
  • Participar de discussões clínicas e auxiliar na construção de condutas conjuntas para casos complexos.

About The Job

Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.

In this role, you will define and execute the regional partner marketing strategy to drive business performance, with the core function being the orchestration of relationships with external business partners to accelerate business growth. Success hinges on your ability to lead and align a team of agencies and Partner Marketers into a unified, cohesive motion, while simultaneously influencing and fostering tight, synergistic partnerships with critical internal stakeholders, including Partner Management, Global Partner Marketing, and local teams, to ensure complete alignment. Key tasks involve leveraging engagement and incentive programs to generate market demand and empowering partners in Go-to‑Market Google Cloud Marketing (GCM) activities to facilitate a partner‑generated pipeline;
this includes co‑owningmarketing plans and goals for segments like Small Medium Business and Enterprise, actively managing partner marketing performance, and setting the strategic direction for brand, visuals, and messaging across all LATAM co‑marketing engagements.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise‑grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting‑edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

  • Influence and enable co‑marketing activities and go‑to‑market motions through partner incentive programs.
  • Manage regional partner marketing budgets, including tracking utilization, claims, and ROI.
  • Nurture existing partner relationships and coordinate various partner engagement motions.

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sr.
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Seu papel:


Como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolvimento de Pipelines Escaláveis: Criar e manter processos de ingestão de dados altamente eficientes (Batch, Streaming, CDC) para grandes volumes, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e resiliência dos dados.
  • Modelagem e Otimização: Projetar, implementar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Data Lake/Lakehouse, orientadas à governança e que atendam às necessidades estratégicas dos times de Analytics e Negócios.
  • Qualidade e Governança: Desenvolver e manter processos de tratamento, aplicando frameworks avançados de validação (como DQX) e garantindo a qualidade e acessibilidade dos dados.
  • Monitoramento e Suporte: Implementar ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento contínuo para garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e conformidade do Data Lake, atuando de forma proativa na resolução de problemas.
  • Liderança Técnica em Governança: Liderar a implantação e utilização do Catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas de governança de dados.


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com as seguintes experiências e conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo e experiência prática na aplicação de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse.
  • Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (scripts, automações, ETL/ELT, PySpark, Pandas) e SQL avançado (tuning de queries, modelagem, window functions ).
  • Nuvem Azure: Experiência avançada com o ecossistema Azure, incluindo Data Factory, Databricks e Data Lake .
  • Engenharia Essencial: Sólida experiência em arquiteturas distribuídas e padrões de ingestão de dados (Batch, Streaming, CDC).
  • Governança de Dados e DataOps: Experiência em catalogação, linhagem, qualidade e aplicação dos princípios de DataOps e DMBoK .
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD com ferramentas como Github .
  • Segurança da Informação: Conhecimento e aplicação da camada de segurança (criptografia, LGPD e mascaramento de dados).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Comunicação Eficaz, Empatia e Colaboração (Interação com Squads).
  • Senso de Urgência e Proatividade no contexto técnico.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas complexos, através de visão analítica e raciocínio lógico.
  • Flexibilidade e Resiliência em cenários de alta complexidade.
  • Paixão pela Qualidade e Visão Holística do negócio.




Diferenciais:

Estes itens não são mandatórios, mas serão considerados um bônus para a posição Sênior:

  • Experiência em Liderança Técnica e/ou Arquitetura de Projetos .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL Server (SSMS, SSIS e SSAS) e ferramentas de visualização como Power BI .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em análise funcional, modelagem de dados e elaboração de documentação técnica de soluções.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de três camadas, ambiente as a service , barramento (BUS) e orquestração.
  • Experiência com API’s para envio e recepção de informações e ferramentas como Excel no contexto de dados.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Databases, Professional Services
description:
Senior Database Consultant, Professional Services

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Senior Database Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Senior Database Consultant you will be proficient in working with customers to migrate their database environments to AWS, architecting complex, scalable, and secure database solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS.

As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key Job Responsibilities
  • Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS database solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  • Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work‑life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture and implementation
  • 5+ years of experience on at least one commercial relational database (Oracle, SQL, Server, IBM, DB2) or open source database (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB)
  • Knowledge of non‑relational database (MongoDB, CouchDB, Redis)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English in technical and business settings
Preferred Qualifications
  • 5+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale implementation experience
  • Experience with automation and scripting (e.G., Terraform, Python)
  • Expertise in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast‑paced environment
  • AWS Professional level certifications (e.G., Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional)
  • Knowledge of the primary AWS services (EC2, ELB, RDS, Route53, S3)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.Js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.

  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

description:
Security Manager

About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Fullstack Sênior – Kotlin/Java + Reactjs
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior para atuar em um projeto temporário (contrato de 3 a 4 meses) , com foco em Kotlin/Java (Spring Boot) no backend e ReactJS no frontend.

Você fará parte de um time técnico de alta performance, responsável por evoluir plataformas escaláveis e de grande impacto, contribuindo tanto na arquitetura e desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços quanto na construção de interfaces ricas e intuitivas para o usuário final.

O perfil ideal é alguém que une sólido conhecimento técnico em engenharia de software com visão de produto, boa comunicação e postura colaborativa, capaz de transitar entre camadas da aplicação com fluidez.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações fullstack , com backend em Kotlin/Java (Spring Boot) e frontend em ReactJS .
  • Participar ativamente do desenho e implementação de arquiteturas escaláveis e evolutivas .
  • Criar e manter APIs GraphQL (principal) e REST , assegurando desempenho e segurança.
  • Projetar e implementar comunicação entre microsserviços utilizando gRPC .
  • Escrever código limpo, testável e eficiente , aplicando princípios de engenharia de software.
  • Garantir qualidade de software através de testes automatizados (unitários, integração e E2E).
  • Apoiar revisões de código e disseminar boas práticas no time.
  • Colaborar com as áreas de produto e design para alinhar soluções à melhor experiência do usuário.
  • Investigar novas tecnologias e propor melhorias contínuas.


Essenciais (ênfase da vaga):

  • Experiência sólida em Kotlin e/ou Java com Spring Boot .
  • Forte base em desenvolvimento frontend com ReactJS , incluindo Hooks , Context API , TypeScript e consumo de APIs GraphQL/REST .
  • Domínio de princípios de design de software (SOLID, Clean Code, Clean Architecture).
  • Cultura de testes automatizados (JUnit, Jest, Testing Library).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL) e não-relacionais (MongoDB, Redis) .
  • Vivência em Git , CI/CD pipelines e deploys em ambientes Kubernetes (AWS ou similar) .


Importantes (secundários, mas valorizados):

  • Experiência em arquitetura de microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos .
  • Experiência com mensageria e filas (Kafka, SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento de componentização e arquitetura microfrontend no frontend.
  • Familiaridade com Node.Js


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de grande escala e ambientes de alta disponibilidade .
  • Atuação prévia em times ágeis com práticas de DevOps .
